'''Magnacuffs''', also known as '''magnetic binders''',<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> were restraining magnetic [[Binders/Legends|cuffs]]<ref name="EGWT" /> made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The cuffs incorporated micromagnetic fields that were used to hold the restraint bands in place,<ref name="EGWT" /> acting as a secondary locking mechanism that made the cuffs hard to foil and effectively tripled the strength of the durasteel.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The [[Lock/Legends|locks]] used on magnacuffs were controlled by coded [[Datachip/Legends|datachips]], or [[Dermatoglyphic identification|fingerprint recognition]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Magnacuffs were used to shackle specially strong individuals, such as the abnormally large [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> The [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Malak (Rodian)|Malak]] carried magnacuffs among her gear.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>

Several models of magnacuffs were available, including [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities']] [[MCI-100 magnacuffs/Legends|MCI-100 magnacuffs]]<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> and [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]]'s [[MagnaCuffs]].<ref name="AE">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
